family_02_structural_pullback.headline: IMPORTANT SIGN NUANCE: 2/3 definitions classify POTENTIALLY_TRADEABLE by |excess| magnitude, but the excess SIGN is the OPPOSITE of the hypothesized continuation effect at 60m/120m (CI excludes zero) -- matched controls (same symbol/time-of-day/vol regime, same borrowed direction, but NOT conditioned on the shallow-pullback pattern) outperform the actual pullback events. A mean-reversion-relative-to-control signature, not a continuation edge -- see summary.md's prominent interpretation caveat. All 3 also flagged EFFECT_SURFACE_INSTABILITY (same_sign_frac=0.44, effect not broadly shared across vol/time-of-day cells).

family_03_range_expansion.tests: tests/test_task67a_family03_range_expansion.py (9 tests, including a dedicated correctness/no-leakage test for the new local `_value_at_offset` helper)
family_03_range_expansion.headline: MOST INTERESTING LEAD ACROSS ALL 3 FAMILIES: `compression90_expansion10_2.5x` (90m-established, 10m-recent, >=2.5x ATR expansion) shows a POSITIVE, hypothesis-ALIGNED excess-vs-matched-control at 60m of +0.258% with a clustered-bootstrap 95% CI of [0.068%, 0.515%] that excludes zero -- STRONG_EFFECT economic classification (excess and MFE both clear 2x the 10bps round-trip friction bar), and concentration is NOT a concern (top1_symbol_share=16.7%, best_day_share=30.3%, both under the 40% flag threshold). Held to WEAK_SIGNAL rather than PHENOMENON_PRESENT for two reasons: (1) only 76 deduplicated events / 24 symbols / 32 days -> data_sufficiency=LIMITED not ADEQUATE (n_events under the 100-event ADEQUATE bar); (2) EFFECT_SURFACE_INSTABILITY flagged (same_sign_frac=0.67, max/median cell-mean ratio=5.66 -- effect not evenly shared across vol/time-of-day cells, some concentration in a subset of regimes). The other two definitions (2.0x/60m-established and 1.75x/45m-established) are PHENOMENON_NOT_OBSERVED -- weaker expansion multiples / longer overlap between established and recent windows do not show the same effect, suggesting the 2.5x-or-higher / short-recent-window shape may matter, not just 'any range expansion'. RECOMMENDATION FOR FAMILY 4-6 / SYNTHESIS PHASE: this specific definition (or a close variant with a slightly larger event count, e.g. relaxing the expansion multiple by a small amount or extending the DEVELOPMENT window) is the single most promising Stage-1 lead found in families 1-3 and is worth a closer, non-cherry-picked look before Stage 1 concludes.
family_03_range_expansion.runtime_wall_clock: a few minutes for all 3 definitions on the full 35-symbol/62-day DEVELOPMENT set (event counts here are far smaller than Families 1-2 -- range-expansion-with-compression is a much rarer condition than trend/pullback, as expected)

family_05_compression_expansion.headline: Clean negative across all 3 definitions, each testing CURRENT compression as a precondition (no requirement a breakout has begun -- distinct from Family 3's breakout-triggered definitions). VOLATILITY_EFFECT_NOT_OBSERVED and DIRECTIONAL_EDGE_NOT_OBSERVED throughout; declining_compression_atr30_lag30 found a genuine non-hypothesis-aligned result (matched controls showed significantly MORE absolute movement, CI excludes zero on the negative side).

family_06_opening_later.headline: THE STANDOUT RESULT OF STAGE 1: all 3 independently-defined signals reach PHENOMENON_PRESENT under the shared taxonomy -- coherent direction across 15/30/60/120m, matched-control CI excludes zero at 15m/60m/120m, POTENTIALLY_TRADEABLE economics, full breadth (35/35 symbols, 63/63 days), low concentration, stable effect surface. CRITICAL: the direction is MEAN-REVERSION (fade), the OPPOSITE of the family's original 'continuation' hypothesis -- see task67b_summary.json for the reframing.
